threads.title: 📰 IconRealms Weekly Newsletter (6/12)
threads.body:
📰 IconRealms Weekly Newsletter

Week of June 12, 2026



🌟 Community Highlights

🏆 May SOTM Winner
Congratulations to Noobie_LOL for being selected as our May Staff Member of the Month!

🎉 Active Giveaway
Don't forget to enter the giveaway in https://discord.com/channels/1457983897936855199/1477381315103031492!

📅 Ends: Monday, June 15



🌐 New Official Website

Our brand-new website is now live!

Website:
https://web.iconrealms.net/home/

Features Include:

     Staff Directory
     Customer & Supporter Recognition
     Forums
     Community Features
     Much More Coming Soon

How To Register

1. Join the server
2. Run:

/register <email> <password>

3. Visit the website
4. Login using:

   * Your Minecraft Username
   * The Password you registered

Note: You do not need to use a real email address. Something simple like:

YourUsername@gmail.com

works perfectly fine.


Website Launch Reward

🎁 Every player who logs into the website receives:

+50 Credits

To claim:

1. Login to the website
2. Take a screenshot proving you're logged in
3. Create one meaningful forum post
4. Submit your screenshot

Website:
https://web.iconrealms.net/



🛒 Store Update

We've updated our store!

Check it out here:
https://icongens.tebex.io/

Be sure to browse the latest offerings and support the network.



💬 Discord Update

Our Discord has received several updates and improvements.

If you haven't already, be sure to check out all the newest channels, announcements, and community features.



📢 NEW Media Rank Creator Codes

Media Rank holders now receive their own exclusive Creator Codes!

Creators can choose between:

💸 Providing their audience with store discounts

OR

💰 Earning a percentage of sales made using their code

   Revenue Share Factors

Creator payouts are customized based on:

• Subscriber/Follower Count
• Average Viewership & Engagement
• Content Activity
• Server Promotion Frequency

   Commission Rates

Creators can earn anywhere from:

**0% → 45% Revenue Share**

The more you help grow the community, the greater the rewards.

Interested in joining?

Apply through:
https://discord.com/channels/1457983897936855199/1457983900574941251



⚙️ IconGens Season 4

Version 5.67 Release Notes

Fixes

✅ Fixed console visibility issues

✅ Increased Multi Max to 1,000

✅ Attempted fixes for:

* Pet Forging
* Rollbacks
* Upgrade Gens
* Pet Multi
* Data Leaks

✅ Fixed backend systems to improve stat stability

✅ Added global booster (sacrificing ores activate a random event)



New Features

✨ Added Gen Placement support inside GenStackers

✨ Added improved Pet Effects

* Speed
* Money Yield
  *(Configuration coming soon)*

✨ Added Head Hunt Event

* Search the server for 25 eggs
* Earn rewards upon completion

✨ Added 3 New Enchants

* Kuro's Gift
* Nuke
* Tidal Wave

✨ Added Fish Index

/index

✨ Added More Fish

✨ Added Fish Mutations

✨ Added Website Registration Command

/register <email> <password>



Reworks & Improvements

🔄 Fishing Rework

🔄 Pet System Rework

🔄 Additional Pet Improvements

🔄 Pet Multi separated between:

* Normal Pets
* Holiday Pets

🔄 Fusion System Improvements

Fusions now have chances to create:

⭐ Huge
⭐ Shiny
⭐ Rainbow



Beta Features

🧪 Free Upgrade Gens
Currently in Beta and undergoing testing.



Quality of Life

🛠️ Made tools unbreakable

🛠️ Adjusted fishing drops



💡 Suggestions Wanted

We are always looking for ways to improve IconRealms.

Make sure to leave your ideas in:

📌 https://discord.com/channels/1457983897936855199/1457983899941470249

Every suggestion is reviewed and helps shape future updates.



❤️ Thank You

Thank you to everyone who continues to support IconRealms.

From the bottom of our hearts we truly are thankful for each and every one of you. 

See you in game!

— IconRealms Ownership

threads.title: SERVER RULES
threads.body:
The following rules are cited from Discord and apply to all players. Breaking these rules may result in warnings, mutes, kicks, bans, or other moderation actions.

Last updated: April 2026

1. Discord Rules
No spamming messages, images, or reactions.
Advertising servers or services in channels or DMs is prohibited.
**** content of any kind is not allowed.
2. Server and Chat Rules
Spamming in chat is not allowed.
Derogatory, hateful, or discriminatory language is prohibited.
Advertising of any kind is not allowed.
Treat all users and staff with respect.
Sharing real or fake personal information is not allowed.
Threats involving DDoS, doxxing, or intimidation are prohibited.
Excessive toxicity is not permitted (moderator discretion).
3. Gameplay Rules
Violations in this section may result in severe punishment.

Inappropriate usernames or skins are not allowed.
Using external tools or background software for unfair advantages is prohibited.
Boosting, exploiting, or automated item generation is not allowed.
Submitting false or misleading evidence is prohibited.
AFK farming and macros are not allowed.
4. Additional Information
Rules may be updated or modified at any time.
Staff decisions are final.
